text: By default the system tracks yearly, quarterly, and monthly fiscal periods. Monthly periods are children of quarterly periods, and quarterly periods children of yearly. Period numbers mean different things for each. For yearly periods the period number is just the year. Quarterly and monthly period numbers are the number within the year. Each period also has a reference to the previous period.
